description.value:
Cryptidkin.

“Every settlement has a story about you. None of them are accurate. All of them are useful.”

Cryptidkin Core Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Cryptidkin).

  • Size. Small or Medium (set by subspecies).

  • Speed. 6 squares (subspecies may override).

  • attributes. Your background determines your attribute increases; Cryptidkin does not grant fixed bonuses. Subspecies lean expressed through Tier powers.

Folklore Presence. When you first encounter an NPC group, the GM chooses (or rolls) whether you are met as omen, trophy, or legend. It is never neutral. People have heard of your kind. They are almost always wrong, and that is almost always useful.

Wasteland Adapted. You reroll the lowest die on checks against disease and environmental poison. You ignore the first nonmagical environmental hazard you encounter each turn (heat, cold, radiation taint, wind shear, fume pockets).

Survivor’s Instinct. When you roll initiative, you can choose to know the position of the nearest exit, the nearest threat, or the nearest ally within 12 squares You cannot be surprised while conscious.

Subspecies. Choose one Cryptidkin subspecies (Chupacabra, Jackalope, Furrykin). Your subspecies grants Tier powers as you level (Tier I at creation, then 5/11/17).

advancement.title: Folklore & Frame
advancement.hint: Gain the core Cryptidkin ancestry traits.

description.value:
"You are not an animal that learned to talk. You are a story the world made into a person because it needed you in the room."

Folklore Presence. 1/Soma Break, when you first meet a community, decide whether the rumors about you arrived first. If yes, reroll the lowest die on your first Diplomacy (Presence) or Intimidation (Presence) check with anyone in that community (your choice which skill, declared when you roll). The rumor is not always flattering — the GM gets to colour it.

Wasteland Adapted. Reroll the lowest die on defense checks against disease and environmental poison. You can subsist on rations that would sicken most humans (spoiled meat, swamp water, mushroom flesh).

Survivor's Instinct. 1/Soma Break, when you would drop to 0 Integrity, you may instead drop to 1 Integrity and gain one level of Stress.

Cryptidkin Subspecies. You are the thing the farmers whisper about. The livestock go quiet, the dogs stop barking, and in the morning there is nothing left but a question the community doesn’t want to ask out loud.

“They didn’t mean anything by the name. They just needed something to blame.”

Chupacabra. Lean, quick, and thirsty in a way that is not quite hunger. You move through the world as a persistent rumor that keeps turning out to be true.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Cryptidkin).

  • Size. Medium.

  • Speed. 6 squares; climb 5 squares

  • Subspecies Lean. Your subspecies leans toward INTR (Intrigue)—expressed through Tier powers.

Core: Folklore & Frame

At creation you gain Folklore & Frame (Folklore Presence, Wasteland Adapted, Survivor’s Instinct).

Chupacabra Tier Powers

You gain Tier I at creation, then Tier II (5), Tier III (11), Tier IV (17). Chupacabra powers emphasize: night-stalker stealth, drain-bite for fluid and Spark, terror aura when spotted, and a reputation that precedes you like a warning sign.

advancement.hint: Gain your Chupacabra Tier I subspecies power.

description.value:
"The goats are gone. So is the witness. So is the noise."

Blood-Drinker (1/Soma Break). When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you may bite. Deal 1d6 + Body value qliphothic damage on top of the attack's normal damage, and gain temporary Integrity equal to the qliphothic damage dealt.

Hex-Sense. You can smell magical residue the way most people smell rain. Once per scene, when something supernatural has happened in a place within the last 24 hours, the GM tells you so — and roughly what colour it was.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Blood-Drinker Recovery: 1/Soma Break  ·  Action: Triggered (on melee hit)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke. When you hit with a melee attack, bite for 1d6 + Body qliphothic damage on top of the attack, and gain temp Integrity equal to the qliphothic damage dealt.

"Strike the clause. Insert your own. Reality reads from the top."

The Cosmic Linguist edits reality like text — meaning first, matter second. One currency now: Surge. The editor always has the next word, so you bank +1 Surge at the start of your turn (the old Resonance, Strain, and Editorial Authority pools are folded into this single pool).

The Edit (spent via Surge)

  • Emphasis (1) — your next Strike or manifestation hits for +Tier d6 (the word, underlined).
  • Stabilize (2) — you gain DR equal to Tier; your next cast resists counter / dispel (the sentence holds).
  • Impose a Reading (3) — a foe's next attack and its saves are rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2 (only one correct interpretation: yours).
  • Rewrite the Sentence (5) — a foe loses its reactions and rolls saves rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2; allies near you bank a reroll.

The Sentence endures as your signature stance — while held, the manifestation's primary target is bound by name and rolls its checks against you rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2.

advancement.title: Cosmic Linguist Discipline (Init 16) — Word That Was

description.value:
"Magic is grammar. Reality is a draft."

You are a prepared, academic manifestant who edits meaning directly. You do not delegate power; you channel it raw.

Engine truth: your craft runs on Clarity (your casting pool, deeper than other paths), Noise (the lattice hears sloppy work), Surge (the editor's one currency — +1 at the start of your turn), and Blood Debt (reaching above your tier, discounted by your Discipline). The cast dialog's cost line is the truth.

An earlier draft of this class spoke of Resonance, Strain, and correspondence alignment. Those pools were folded into Surge — the fiction survives; the bookkeeping does not.

The Edit — your four class Surge spends, from the ◆ Surge menu.

  • Emphasis (1) — your next Strike or manifestation hits for +Tier d6 (the word, underlined).
  • Stabilize (2) — you gain DR equal to Tier; your next cast explodes on 9–10 (the sentence holds).
  • Impose a Reading (3) — a foe's next attack and its saves roll 3d10 and keep the lowest 2. Only one correct interpretation: yours.
  • Rewrite the Sentence (5) — a foe loses its reactions and rolls saves rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2; allies near you bank a reroll.

These are the old Resonance channels spoken in the one currency: Surge. The Sentence (Initiation 11) endures as your signature stance on top of them.

"I am not casting. I am editing."

Roleplay register, not rules. Choose the voice of your edits — Additive, Subtractive, Transformative, Referential, or Performative. Narrate every manifestation in your mode: it shapes how the working looks, sounds, and is remembered — never what it costs.

The cast dialog's cost line is the truth. (An earlier draft priced modes in Strain; Strain is retired.)

Initiation 1 — True-Name Touch. You bank +1 Surge at the start of each of your turns (max +2 a round). When you spend Clarity to manifest, you may name the target as part of the action. For the rest of the scene, extending that manifestation's Reach to the named target costs 1 less Surge / Blood Debt (minimum 0).

Discipline (passive): Reach discount −1 on Blood-Debt-reach. Skill rank +1 in two of: Occult, Lore, Insight.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — True-Name Touch Recovery: At-will (per scene)  ·  Action: Bonus (with manifestation)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke. Name a target as part of your manifestation. For the rest of the scene, extending that manifestation's Reach to the named target costs 1 less Surge (min 0).

description.value:
"Say what counts as what now. Reality is listening."

Doctrine: Reality bends when likeness is declared and believed — your workings hinge on symbolic equivalence.

The Metaphor Apostle rules by declaration. Your Surge spends rewrite what things are: an ally becomes a wall, a foe's armor becomes paper, and your whole line becomes giants.

Doctrine (spent via Surge)

  • Declared Likeness (1) — "you are a wall": an ally gains DR equal to Tier.
  • Declared Frailty (2) — "their armor is paper": a foe's next attack and its saves are rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2.
  • Apotheosis (5) — "you are all giants": allies within 6 squares gain DR equal to Tier and a reroll.

Effect: Create an allegorical manifestation (Judge, Mirror, Choir, Hungry Crown). It provides control, distraction, and leverage without direct damage (GM adjudication).

Battlefield Presence

People fight better when you are near.

Rules

Allies within 2 squares of you reroll the lowest die on the first defense checks they make against being Shaken or charmed each combat.

✍ Aura — the GM applies the reroll to the allies' first defense checks against Shaken or charm each combat.

(3rd Level)

You anchor manifestations to declared metaphors.

When you cast illusion or enchantment, you may declare a symbolic anchor:

  • Crown

  • Chain

  • Mirror

  • Storm

  • Fire

  • Mask

  • Hunt

  • Etc.

If the metaphor is meaningfully relevant in the scene:

  • Bank Surge.

If the metaphor is contradicted:

  • Immediately gain misfire risk.

This is not flavor.

The metaphor must be maintained.

(3rd Level)

You establish a symbolic hook in the scene.

Declare a symbol (sigil, phrase, icon, prop).

For the rest of the scene:

  • Manifestations referencing that symbol may gain additional Surge.

  • Influence may extend further when narratively aligned.

Hooks reward continuity.

Symbols want to propagate.

Bladed Tempo

Your weapons are punctuation.

Rules

When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you may immediately draw or stow a weapon, or shift 1 square without provoking reaction strikes.

✍ Table rule.

Initiation 6 — Translation. 1/scene signature move: as a reaction to an ally completing a manifestation within Reach, transcribe it into your idiom. Until the end of the next round, you carry their effect at your tier cap, paying its upkeep from your Clarity. Your translation, your bill.

Discipline: passive Reach discount unchanged from Init 1; Translation itself is a 1/scene narrative power resolved at the table.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Translation Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Reaction  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke. When an ally completes a manifestation within Reach, transcribe it into your idiom. Carry their effect at your tier cap until end of next round; pay upkeep from your Clarity.

(6th Level)

You bind behavior to story roles.

Choose an archetype:

  • The Betrayer

  • The Tyrant

  • The Martyr

  • The Fool

  • The Guardian

  • The Tempter

The target must play the role:

  • Hesitate

  • Monologue

  • Retreat

  • Confess

  • Overreach

  • Submit to a constraint

Cost

Generates misfire risk if forced aggressively.

Clarification

This does not override free will.
It constrains choices within archetypal gravity.

The more resistant the target, the greater the misfire risk.

description.value:
Adaptive Defense

Defense is not denial. It is management.

Rules

When you are hit by an attack you can see, you may use your reaction to reduce the damage by an amount equal to your rank bonus + your Violence or Intrigue value (your choice).

🃏 Card — click ▶ when you are hit: it shows the reduction (rank bonus + Violence or Intrigue).

(10th Level)

You cast across groups through shared symbolism.

Choose a collective identity:

  • Crowd

  • Mob

  • Choir

  • Army

  • Congregation

  • Survivors

You may affect the group as a unified symbolic system:

  • Shared illusion

  • Shared fear

  • Shared calm

  • Shared belief

It feels like fate—not domination.

Surge Interaction

Group alignment can bank additional Surge.

Risk

If the shared metaphor fractures, misfire risk spikes.
